summary: Tested multi-language (FR/EN) + multi-currency (XOF/EUR/USD) feature end-to-end: backend /api/geo returns correct locales for US/DE/SN IPs, LocaleSwitcher toggles UI + currency across all 3 flags and persists after reload, checkout flow works in FR/XOF and EN/USD with correct XOF note + button texts, embedded Stripe iframe renders in matching locale (English fields for EN/USD, French for FR/XOF - 'Payer en toute securite', 'Informations de la carte'), Paxity mobile money methods (Orange Money, Wave, MTN) still present on payment step. Regression pages /, /boutique, /produit/p_4853be43d7, /achat-en-gros, /suivi, /panier load correctly. Test orders + payment_transactions cleaned up, order_number counter reset to 0 as requested.

ui_bugs.issue: Body content NOT translated to English when locale=en/USD. Heading still shows 'Ou est mon colis ?' and paragraph 'Entrez votre numero de commande (recu apres le paiement) pour suivre votre colis' remain in French. Only the shared navbar/footer are translated. Spec explicitly requires 'Where is my package?' + English texts on this page.

action_items: Translate /suivi (Tracking) page body: heading 'Ou est mon colis ?' -> 'Where is my package?' and the descriptive paragraph + any form labels/buttons on that page. Only navbar/footer are currently wrapped in t().
critical_code_review_comments: Tracking page component appears to have hardcoded FR strings for the H1/description rather than using the t() dictionary from /app/frontend/src/lib/locale.js. Confirm src/pages/Tracking.jsx (or Suivi.jsx) uses useLocale/t for every visible string.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeds only (sec_site_unlocked_v1, sec_locale_v1, sec_cart_v1). Two pending Stripe test orders (#1000, #1001) with email test@example.com were created during embedded-iframe verification and have been fully cleaned up: db.orders.delete_many({'customer.email':'test@example.com'}) -> 2 removed; db.payment_transactions delete for order_id 1000/1001 -> 2 removed; db.counters {'_id':'order_number'} seq reset to 0.
test_credentials: Site password: alarba2026 (or localStorage sec_site_unlocked_v1). No seller login required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend geo endpoint verified via pytest (4/4 pass) with X-Forwarded-For for 8.8.8.8/78.46.0.1/41.82.0.1. LocaleSwitcher (data-testid locale-switcher-btn/locale-option-{sn,eu,us}) works and persists. Checkout in FR/XOF: no stripe-xof-note, button 'Payer par carte 1 500 F'. Checkout in EN/USD: labels First name/Last name/ZIP/Email/etc, note 'The amount is charged in F CFA: 1 500 F CFA', button 'Pay by card $2', embedded iframe (data-testid stripe-embedded-checkout) renders with English Stripe UI. FR embedded Stripe renders with French Stripe UI. Only remaining defect: /suivi body content not translated in EN mode (nav/footer are).
rca_of_the_issue: The /suivi (Tracking) page component contains hardcoded French copy (h1 'Ou est mon colis ?' and descriptive paragraph) instead of using t(key) from lib/locale.js. LocaleContext + dictionary infra work correctly (proven by navbar/footer/checkout translating). Fix: wrap Tracking page strings with t() and add corresponding EN keys ('tracking.title' -> 'Where is my package?', tracking.description, tracking.form.* etc).
